title: metais.unpack/1
description: What metais unpack prints with --json: the files of the source directory it wrote, or with --dry-run would write (ADR-007 D8, ADR-008 D9).

dry_run.description: Whether --dry-run was given, so that nothing was written.

files.description: Each file written, or with --dry-run that would be, as a path relative to the directory unpack writes into, in the order written: every entry of the package but those beneath .compiled/, in byte order.
